title: Portfolio Guardian
tagline: An AI-powered portfolio guardian that monitors news, social sentiment, and on-chain data to detect risks and automatically trigger protective actions across all connected wallets.
description: The AI-Powered Portfolio Guardian is a solution designed to assist cryptocurrency investors in effectively managing their assets across multiple wallets. By leveraging artificial intelligence, this platform offers real-time monitoring of cryptocurrency holdings, analyzes news and social media sentiment, and executes automated protective actions in response to potential risks. This approach ensures that investors remain informed and can respond swiftly to market fluctuations and security and scam detection, thereby safeguarding their investments.
how_its_made:
- Dashboard: made with Nextjs, Typescript and deployed with Vercel. We use Privy to allow user to quickly link all their wallets. You can call the AI monitoring stack to scan your assets. We currently support baseSepolia, Base mainnet and sepolia testnet.
- AI monitoring stack: multi AI agents system made with crewAI and deployed on Autonome. Monitor news, social media, onchain data and smart contract security information to find suspicious coin. If a suspivious coin is detected, it call the onchain agent.
- Onchain agent: built with coinbase agentKit and Privy server wallet, this agent send you a notification on telegram and offers you to sell the suspicious asset for you. Deployed on Autonome.
